# Player Dealt Final Blow

Source: [1736](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1736); edited 2023-01-19. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1736-n1"></a>

- Final Blow includes suicide; Event Player/Attacker is the killer and Victim is the dying player, all equal on suicide.

<a id="wiki-1736-n2"></a>

- Context includes final damage amount, critical hit, Event Ability and incoming Event Direction; this event is distinct from merely earning elimination credit.
